hooks.name: Architecture Layer Guard
hooks.description: Verifies Clean Architecture dependency rules: domain layer must not import from outer layers (application, data, controllers, views, di). Checks both module-specific and core domain files.

action.prompt:
A domain layer file was saved. Verify it follows Clean Architecture dependency rules:

ALLOWED imports in domain/:
- Other files within the same domain/ folder
- src/core/domain/ (shared domain types)
- TypeScript built-ins

FORBIDDEN imports in domain/:
- application/ (use cases)
- data/ (services, schemas, zod)
- controllers/ (hooks, mappers)
- views/ (React components)
- di/ (Awilix, container)
- Any framework: React, Next.js, zod, awilix, fetch, window, Date.now()

Check the file's import statements. If any violation is found, report:
1. The violating import line
2. Which rule it breaks
3. How to fix it (usually by moving the dependency to a protocol or removing it)

If no violations, confirm the file follows domain layer rules.
